title: Healthy habit of the day: Add some strength training
excerpt: Exercises such as squats, push-ups and resistance bands help maintain muscle, which supports a healthy metabolism as you age.
content: Exercises such as squats, push-ups and resistance bands help maintain muscle, which supports a healthy metabolism as you age.
Two sessions a week is a common starting point. Learn the movements slowly and consider a qualified trainer.
This is general information, not medical advice. Speak to a doctor or dietitian before changing your diet or exercise, especially if you have a health condition.
